bio:
A Chartered Statistician who specialises in using data and statistical evidence to advance financial inclusion and inform policy. At FinMark Trust, he has contributed to demand-side surveys, financial access mapping, gender and youth research, data visualisation, and training and capacity-building engagement with ministries of finance and central banks across diverse markets.

Recently, Abel has focused on unpacking the impact of financial inclusion, asking: “Are we winning the financial inclusion war?” His work explores how data can move beyond access and uptake to understand outcomes such as responsible borrowing, sustained saving, resilience, financial wellbeing and development, and how these outcomes can be meaningfully measured and interpreted. He holds a master’s degree in Statistics.
name: Abel Motsomi
